## Description {#details}

<p>Machine <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/value">Value</a> <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/type">Type</a>.</p>


<p>Every type that is supported natively by some processor targeted by LLVM occurs here. This means that any legal value type can be represented by an <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/mvt">MVT</a>.</p>
